patch_description: The prior best-performing variant (score 0.63) used all-CRZ entangling gates with shared parameters on the (0,8)/(1,8)/(2,6) redundant pairs and full individual RZ post-rotations. The current variant regressed (0.59) after switching several CRZ gates to CRY and merging RZ post-rotations on adjacent-index pairs (0-1,2-3,4-5,6-7). This edit reverts the CRY gates back to CRZ (restoring the higher-scoring entangling structure) while still applying end-stage parameter compression, but now using symmetric qubit-pair sharing (0↔8, 1↔7, 2↔6, 3↔5, with 4 alone) as recommended, which respects the topological symmetry of the coupling map better than the previous adjacent-index merge and should preserve expressivity while cutting params from 9→5 in that layer.
